limitations: Incremental prefix skip originally relied on the constructed generator, without a validated parent record or complete state/model/profile bindings.
Full final validation and original result labels shared the same check and rollout functions; repeated fresh MjData is not an independent oracle.
Dynamic rollout always covers the full final plan; only static prefix samples are reused.
Obstacles are constructed from final-plan FK locations, rather than sampled independently from a deployment environment.
Protocol-frozen flag was hardcoded; no externally timestamped preregistration.
Aggregate timing mixes early rejects with dynamic rollouts, uses fixed method order and a single run.
